# --- Paths into the PSoC Creator workspace ---
set(CYDSN_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(GENERATED_DIR ${CYDSN_DIR}/Generated_Source/PSoC5)
set(LIB_DIR ${PROJECT_ROOT}/src/libraries)
set(COMMON_DIR ${PROJECT_ROOT}/src/common)
set(BOOTLOADER_PROJECT_NAME ${PROJECT_NAME}_bootloader)
# --- PSoC Creator generated sources: device init, HAL, component drivers ---
# This directory is regenerated by PSoC Creator, so its contents are globbed
# rather than listed by hand.
file(GLOB GENERATED_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${GENERATED_DIR}/*.c)

# --- Application sources ---
set(APP_SOURCES
    ${CYDSN_DIR}/main.c
    ${CYDSN_DIR}/bootloader.c
    ${CYDSN_DIR}/vers.c
)

set(FIRMWARE_TARGET ${BOOTLOADER_PROJECT_NAME}.elf)

add_executable(${FIRMWARE_TARGET}
    ${GENERATED_DIR}/CyBootAsmGnu.s
    ${GENERATED_SOURCES}
    ${APP_SOURCES}
    ${THIRD_PARTY_SOURCES}
    ${COMMON_DIR}/logging.c
    ${COMMON_DIR}/app_utils.c
)

target_include_directories(${FIRMWARE_TARGET} PRIVATE
    ${CYDSN_DIR}
    ${GENERATED_DIR}
    ${LIB_DIR}
    ${COMMON_DIR}
)

# Mirrors the "Debug@CortexM3" build configuration in rc-car-peripheral-controller.cyprj
target_compile_definitions(${FIRMWARE_TARGET} PRIVATE
    DEBUG
    CY_CORE_ID=0
    BOOTLOADER=1
    # Where the application image starts in flash (see CY_BOOTLOADER_SIZE in
    # the root CMakeLists.txt) - the bootloader jumps here once it decides
    # not to stay resident.
    APPL_START_ADDR=${CY_BOOTLOADER_SIZE}
)

set(CPU_FLAGS -mcpu=cortex-m3 -mthumb -mfloat-abi=soft)

target_compile_options(${FIRMWARE_TARGET} PRIVATE
    ${CPU_FLAGS}
    -fsigned-char
    -ffunction-sections
    -fdata-sections
    -Wall
    -Og
    -g3
)

set(LINKER_SCRIPT ${GENERATED_DIR}/cm3gcc.ld)

target_link_options(${FIRMWARE_TARGET} PRIVATE
    ${CPU_FLAGS}
    -T${LINKER_SCRIPT}
    -L${GENERATED_DIR}
    --specs=nano.specs
    -u_printf_float
    -Wl,--gc-sections
    -Wl,-Map=${BOOTLOADER_PROJECT_NAME}.map
)

set_target_properties(${FIRMWARE_TARGET} PROPERTIES LINK_DEPENDS ${LINKER_SCRIPT})

# cm3gcc.ld places these at pseudo-addresses (0x8xxxxxxx/0x9xxxxxxx) that only
# mean something to Cypress's own PSoC Programmer tool, which splits them out
# during production programming. OpenOCD's psoc5lp flash driver has no bank
# at those addresses, so leaving them in the .hex/.bin breaks `program`.
set(CY_PSEUDO_SECTION_STRIP
    -R .cyconfigecc
    -R .cycustnvl
    -R .cywolatch
    -R .cyeeprom
    -R .cyflashprotect
    -R .cymeta
)

# --- Post-build: .hex/.bin + size report ---
# The bootloader's actual budget is the reserved region at the start of
# flash (CY_BOOTLOADER_SIZE, set in the root CMakeLists.txt) - not the full
# 262144-byte part, which belongs to the application past CY_APPL_ORIGIN.
set(CY_ROM_SIZE ${CY_BOOTLOADER_SIZE})
set(CY_RAM_SIZE 65536)

add_custom_command(TARGET ${FIRMWARE_TARGET} POST_BUILD
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_OBJCOPY} -O ihex ${CY_PSEUDO_SECTION_STRIP} $<TARGET_FILE:${FIRMWARE_TARGET}> ${BOOTLOADER_PROJECT_NAME}.hex
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_OBJCOPY} -O binary ${CY_PSEUDO_SECTION_STRIP} $<TARGET_FILE:${FIRMWARE_TARGET}> ${BOOTLOADER_PROJECT_NAME}.bin
    # Debug-safe ELF: same pseudo-sections stripped, but DWARF debug info kept
    # intact (objcopy -R only removes the sections named above), so a
    # debugger can `load` this directly without hitting the same flash-bank
    # error, while still getting full source-level debugging.
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_OBJCOPY} -O elf32-littlearm ${CY_PSEUDO_SECTION_STRIP} $<TARGET_FILE:${FIRMWARE_TARGET}> ${BOOTLOADER_PROJECT_NAME}.flash.elf
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_SIZE} $<TARGET_FILE:${FIRMWARE_TARGET}>
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
        -DELF_FILE=$<TARGET_FILE:${FIRMWARE_TARGET}>
        -DCMAKE_SIZE=${CMAKE_SIZE}
        -DCY_ROM_SIZE=${CY_ROM_SIZE}
        -DCY_RAM_SIZE=${CY_RAM_SIZE}
        -P ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/ReportMemoryUsage.cmake
    COMMENT "Generating .hex/.bin/.flash.elf and size report for ${FIRMWARE_TARGET}"
)
